sentences.en: You know, I've spoken with veterans who have personally tried to bring those people who helped them, translators and others to the United States, bring them to safety.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我曾与一些退伍军人交谈过，他们曾亲自试图将那些帮助过他们的翻译和其他人带到美国，带他们去安全的地方。

sentences.en: I mean, the plot point of this idea of Afghans helping American military members has been in movies and shows.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，阿富汗人帮助美国军人的这种情节一直出现在电影和节目中。

sentences.en: And for now, this idea of helping Afghans who helped the American military in Afghanistan, that's over.
sentences.zh: 而现在，帮助在阿富汗协助过美军的阿富汗人的这种想法，已经结束了。

sentences.en: Just to end, Hamid, I don't want to entirely lose sight of the National Guard and its place in this story.
sentences.zh: 最后，哈米德，我不想完全忽视国民警卫队及其在这则故事中的地位。

sentences.en: The second Guardsman who was shot remains in critical condition in a hospital.
sentences.zh: 第二名中枪的国民警卫队员目前仍在医院接受重症监护。

sentences.en: And this deployment of the National Guard in Washington remains a source of really profound controversy.
sentences.zh: 在华盛顿部署国民警卫队仍然是一个引发深刻争议的来源。

sentences.en: Yeah, this idea of bringing the federal forces to the city was really opposed by a lot of citizens in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 是的，将联邦部队带到这座城市的想法确实遭到华盛顿特区许多市民的反对。

sentences.en: But in the days since the shooting, President Trump has announced that he was planning to send 500 more National Guard members to Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 但在枪击事件发生后的几天里，特朗普总统宣布他计划向华盛顿特区增派500名国民警卫队员。

sentences.en: So now this deployment, far from shrinking because of this shooting, is now going to expand because of it.
sentences.zh: 所以现在这次部署非但没有因为这次枪击而缩减，反而要因此而扩大了。

sentences.en: Mohammed, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 穆罕默德，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: On Sunday, the Secretary of Homeland Security, Kristi Knoll, told NBC News that the alleged
sentences.zh: 周日，国土安全部长克里斯蒂·诺尔对全国广播公司新闻网表示，这名涉嫌

sentences.en: shooter may not have become radicalized until after he immigrated to the United States.
sentences.zh: 枪手可能是在移民美国之后才被激进化的。

sentences.en: That conclusion, if true, could undermine the Trump administration's claims that the Biden administration had failed to properly vet him before he arrived into the country.
sentences.zh: 这一结论如果属实，可能会削弱特朗普政府的说法，即拜登政府在他抵达该国之前未能对他进行适当的审查。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: Over the past few days, President Trump has carried out a series of profoundly contradictory actions in his war against drug cartels.
sentences.zh: 在过去几天里，特朗普总统在他的打击贩毒集团之战中实施了一系列极其矛盾的行动。

sentences.en: Trump declared in a post on social media that the airspace above and around Venezuela, which he is accused of flooding the U.S.
sentences.zh: 特朗普在社交媒体上发文宣称，委内瑞拉上空及周边空域——他指控委内瑞拉向美国

sentences.en: with drugs, should now be considered closed.
sentences.zh: 倾销毒品——现在应被视为关闭状态。

sentences.en: It was his latest threat against the regime of Venezuela's authoritarian leader, Nicolas Maduro.
sentences.zh: 这是他对委内瑞拉威权领导人尼古拉斯·马杜罗政权的最新威胁。

sentences.en: But at the same time, Trump announced a full pardon of a former president of Honduras, Juan
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，特朗普宣布全面赦免洪都拉斯前总统

sentences.en: Orlando Hernandez, who has been convicted in U.S.
sentences.zh: 胡安·奥兰多·埃尔南德斯，此人曾在美国
zh_words: 胡安·奥兰多·埃尔南德斯

sentences.en: federal court of conspiring with local drug cartels to bring vast amounts of cocaine into the United States.
sentences.zh: 联邦法院被定罪，罪名是与当地贩毒集团勾结，向美国输入大量可卡因。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, on Sunday, members of Congress from both parties said that the Trump administration
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在周日，来自两党的国会议员表示，特朗普政府

sentences.en: may have committed a war crime in its offensive against boats allegedly carrying drugs in the
sentences.zh: 在其针对据称在

sentences.en: Caribbean.
sentences.zh: 加勒比海运毒船只的攻势中，可能犯下了战争罪。

sentences.en: According to The Washington Post, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth gave a verbal order to kill everyone aboard such boats, leading a U.S.
sentences.zh: 根据《华盛顿邮报》报道，国防部长皮特·海格塞斯曾下达口头命令，要杀死此类船只上的所有人，导致一名美国

sentences.en: military commander to carry out a second strike to kill those who had survived an initial airstrike back in September.
sentences.zh: 军事指挥官在9月实施了第二次打击，以杀死那些在最初空袭中幸存下来的人。

sentences.en: Do you believe if there was a second strike to eliminate any survivors, that that constitutes a war crime?
sentences.zh: 你认为是否存在旨在消灭任何幸存者的第二次打击，这是否构成了战争罪？

sentences.en: It seems to.
sentences.zh: 似乎是的。

sentences.en: If what has been reported is accurate, I've got serious concerns about anybody in that, you know, chain of command stepping over a line that they should never step over.
sentences.zh: 如果所报道的内容准确的话，我对指挥链中的任何人越过他们绝不应该越过的红线，感到严重关切。

sentences.en: You know, going after survivors in the water, that is clearly not lawful.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，追击水中的幸存者，这显然是不合法的。

sentences.en: Both Democratic Senator Mark Kelly of Arizona on CNN and Republican Representative Mike Turner of Ohio on CBS said that such a second strike would violate the rules of war.
sentences.zh: 来自亚利桑那州的民主党参议员马克·凯利在有线电视新闻网（CNN）上和来自俄亥俄州的共和党众议员迈克·特纳在哥伦比亚广播公司（CBS）上均表示，此类第二次打击将违反战争规则。

sentences.en: Obviously, if that occurred, that would be very serious.
sentences.zh: 显然，如果那发生了，将会是非常严重的事情。

sentences.en: And I agree that that would be an illegal act.
sentences.zh: 我同意那会是一项非法的行为。

sentences.en: Turner said that the Post's reporting on the second strike would become the focus of an existing congressional investigation into the airstrikes on the boats.
sentences.zh: 特纳表示，《华盛顿邮报》关于第二次空袭的报道将成为国会现有的针对船只空袭调查的焦点。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一个严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自称为改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，党内一直陷入一场激烈、混乱且有时令人兴奋的争斗之中。
